{{- /* Valine — full upstream-equivalent loader */ -}} {{- $v := .Site.Params.valine | default dict -}} {{- if not (and ($v.appId | default "") ($v.appKey | default "")) }}{{/* credentials required */}}{{ else }} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $lazyload := $c.lazyload | default false -}} {{- $option := $v.option | default dict -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- $first := "" }}{{ if gt (len $norm) 0 }}{{ $first = index $norm 0 }}{{ end -}} {{- $js := $v.js | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/valine@1.5.1/dist/Valine.min.js" -}} {{- $avatar := $v.avatar | default "mp" -}} {{- $serverURLs := $v.serverURLs | default "" -}} {{- $visitor := $v.visitor | default false -}} {{- /* Optional site data for emojiMaps: data/valine.* */ -}} {{- $emojiMaps := dict -}} {{- with site.Data.valine }}{{ $emojiMaps = . }}{{ end -}} {{- end }}
